The promo code discount amount shown for the return trip in the email confirmation matches the discount applied to the return line item in the order payload.

The system displays the correct total discount in the email confirmation that equals the sum of the promo code discount amounts shown for the outbound and return trips.

notes: Reviewed openspec's 8 ACs — they are well-structured and cover the core bug fix, data consistency, single/return-only promo scopes, zero/fully-discounted edge case, no-promo negative case, and total summation. Added 4 new criteria: (1) currency formatting consistency for the return trip discount display, (2) label/formatting consistency between outbound and return discount lines to prevent the fix from rendering the return discount in a visually inconsistent way, (3) outbound-only promo negative case — openspec covered return-only promo (AC5) but not the symmetric case where the promo only applies to outbound, and (4) negative discount amount edge case to guard against corrupt payload data producing a negative displayed discount. No ACs were removed or reworded; all original ACs were retained as-is.
